parameters.query:
={{`WITH target AS (
  SELECT
    mission_id,
    autofix_attempts,
    CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE((regexp_match(udn_mission, '#af:.*enabled=(true|false)'))[1], 'true')) = 'true' THEN true ELSE false END AS ctrl_enabled,
    GREATEST(1, LEAST(2, COALESCE(NULLIF((regexp_match(udn_mission, '#af:.*max_rounds=([0-9]+)'))[1], '')::int, 2))) AS ctrl_max_rounds,
    COALESCE(NULLIF((regexp_match(udn_mission, '#af:.*on_exhaust=([a-z_]+)'))[1], ''), 'pause_owner') AS ctrl_on_exhaust
  FROM gov.missions
  WHERE mission_id = '${$input.first().json.mission_id}'
), upd AS (
  UPDATE gov.missions m
  SET
    autofix_attempts = CASE
      WHEN NOT t.ctrl_enabled THEN m.autofix_attempts
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts < t.ctrl_max_rounds THEN t.autofix_attempts + 1
      ELSE t.autofix_attempts
    END,
    autofix_state = CASE
      WHEN NOT t.ctrl_enabled THEN 'resolved'
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts >= t.ctrl_max_rounds THEN 'paused_waiting_owner'
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts = 0 THEN 'round_1'
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts = 1 THEN 'round_2'
      ELSE 'paused_waiting_owner'
    END,
    autofix_last_error_code = '${$input.first().json.error_code}',
    autofix_last_error_excerpt_256 = LEFT('${$input.first().json.error_excerpt}', 256),
    owner_call_required = CASE
      WHEN NOT t.ctrl_enabled THEN false
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts >= t.ctrl_max_rounds THEN true
      ELSE false
    END,
    paused_reason = CASE
      WHEN NOT t.ctrl_enabled THEN NULL
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts >= t.ctrl_max_rounds THEN 'AUTO_FIX_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'
      ELSE paused_reason
    END
  FROM target t
  WHERE m.mission_id = t.mission_id
  RETURNING m.mission_id, m.autofix_attempts, m.autofix_state, m.owner_call_required, t.ctrl_enabled, t.ctrl_max_rounds, t.ctrl_on_exhaust
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) THEN true ELSE false END AS found,
  COALESCE((SELECT mission_id FROM upd), '') AS mission_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT autofix_attempts FROM upd), -1) AS autofix_attempts,
  COALESCE((SELECT autofix_state FROM upd), 'not_found') AS autofix_state,
  COALESCE((SELECT owner_call_required FROM upd), false) AS owner_call_required,
  COALESCE((SELECT ctrl_enabled FROM upd), true) AS control_enabled,
  COALESCE((SELECT ctrl_max_rounds FROM upd), 2) AS control_max_rounds,
  COALESCE((SELECT ctrl_on_exhaust FROM upd), 'pause_owner') AS control_on_exhaust,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) AND (SELECT ctrl_enabled FROM upd) = false THEN 'autofix_disabled'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) AND (SELECT autofix_state FROM upd) = 'paused_waiting_owner' THEN 'pause_owner'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) THEN 'retry_limited'
    ELSE 'mission_not_found'
  END AS next_action;`}}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'ok', mission_id: $json.mission_id, autofix_attempts: Number($json.autofix_attempts || 0), autofix_state: $json.autofix_state, owner_call_required: !!$json.owner_call_required, control: { enabled: !!$json.control_enabled, max_rounds: Number($json.control_max_rounds || 2), on_exhaust: $json.control_on_exhaust || 'pause_owner' }, next_action: $json.next_action } }}
